component.name: Locus
component.summary: A workspace for study and research

description.p: Locus is a local workspace for reading books and papers, drawing handwritten notes, and returning to your study materials. Study independently without an AI account.

ul.li: Organize PDFs into workspaces and folders without moving or copying the original files.
Read continuously, follow document links, and return to your saved reading position.
Write and sketch on Excalidraw whiteboards saved locally as portable drawing files.
Arrange up to four resizable panes for reading and drawing side by side.
Customize keyboard shortcuts and choose a light or dark appearance.
